card.name: Inside anhydroglucitol and aspartate names
card.fires_on: The middle piece of long lab-term names, such as the 'uc' in 1,5-anhydroglucitol and the 'ate' in aspartate aminotransferase. It fires just before the name finishes and its abbreviation (1,5-AG, AST) appears.

modes.label: Anhydroglucitol
modes.description: The 'uc' piece inside 1,5-anhydroglucitol in the SGLT2 inhibitor lab-interference warning.

modes.label: Aspartate aminotransferase
modes.description: The 'ate' ending of aspartate just before aminotransferase (AST) in lab-abnormality text.

card.plain: It lights up partway through the long lab-test names anhydroglucitol and aspartate aminotransferase.
